Task: Medical Headshot Conversion
Subject Retention: Preserve original face, eyes, smile, hair, head pose, and identity from [INPUT_PHOTO].
Attire Swap:
Replace top attire with a bright blue collared shirt under a white medical lab coat.
DO NOT Add a black and metallic stethoscope hanging around the neck. remove it.
Remove casual jewelry (earrings, necklaces).
Environment & Background:
Seamless, bright, solid white background (#FFFFFF).
High-key, bright, soft professional lighting (no harsh dark shadows).
Style: Crisp, realistic, 8k professional studio portrait photo.
Key Instructions Included in the Prompt:
Clothing Match: Converts any dark dress/suit into the exact blue shirt + white coat + stethoscope combination shown in the reference photo.
Background Change: Forces the removal of dark/grey/textured backgrounds and replaces them with a clean, high-key white background.
Identity Preservation: Instructs the AI to focus strictly on changing attire and background while keeping the person's face identical.
